_comment: Master NPC registry. All NPC data lives here. Dialogs and actions reference NPCs by their key. 'backstory' and 'knowledge' were added 2026-07-24 for enacted characters (see the /enact skill and README §8) - both optional for hand-built NPCs, but /enact always fills them in. As of 2026-07-25, knowledge is split into 'education' (the immutable sample drawn once at creation - never redrawn or edited after) and 'experience' (what the character has picked up since: their own dialog lines beyond the sample, plus - conceptually - their 'backstory' field above, which is also experience-knowledge, just kept as its own top-level field since it predates this split and is used elsewhere as plain character description).

gondarfolas.backstory: A seafarer normally based in Görff, travelling all around the continent. Owns a small ship he uses to take travellers from coast to coast. An avid reader of history, well versed in the history of Milkantis. Has a knack for exaggerating some things. Per the Luminacion Register, also based in Terfila on the return leg of the ferry run ("Sailing to Gorff") - the same sailor working both directions, per the register's own matched pair.

experience: Owns a small ship and regularly runs a route past Catraniz and Sit Nalta.
Has an old copy of the Ensayo (era nine) and a copy of the Libro, and knows the two chronicles don't reconcile with each other (CONFLICT-01).

Bought his history books years ago from a trader in Görff he recalls as 'Bracco, or Braggo' - a big, heavily scarred man who sold them off cheaply and asked no questions; Gondarfolas has no idea where the man came from or went.
Has never been to Khol Moshin - as a sailor, he only goes where there's coastline.

Heard (via a traveler, unconfirmed) that Därnis's siblings are organizing a search expedition, departing from where a highway ends at the continent's southern tip - new information to him, not something he can confirm.

nuvilo.backstory: A distant descendant of Navalius, the founder of Nvhi. Like many in his line, he has chosen to follow the path of knowledge, seeking to bring new light into the world through discovery. He has traveled to the Feria del Milenio to celebrate the 1000 years of Milkantis, hoping to find inspiration for his work among its exhibits - a homage to Milkantis's cultures and building styles, its landscapes, its artifacts (redstone contraptions, datapacks, mods), and its historical eras. Old childhood friend of Nerkeli, a pilot he ran into again at the fair. Despite the family's claimed tie to Nvhi's founding, he readily admits he knows little of the place's actual history - the family kept the name, not the history.

experience: Is pursuing 'the path of knowledge' at the Feria del Milenio, hoping the exhibits inspire his next work.
Claims descent from 'Navalius,' said to have founded Nvhi generations back - though he admits he knows little else about Nvhi's actual history, just the family name.
Cites highway M9 (Nvhi -> Khan Ice) as personally significant given that claimed family connection.
Picked up from Nerkeli in this conversation: Nerkeli's joke theory that ducks descend from the Daax, and that Nerkeli's own M7 route (Puente Intercontinental -> Nvhi) passes right by Nvhi's edge.
Holds no official role at the Feria - just a visiting scholar looking for inspiration, unlike friends of his (e.g. Nerkeli) actually running an exhibit.

Writes about historical inventors and travelers - naming Daaxagoras, Pitaglorias, and Darnis to a traveler - and keeps circling an unsolved puzzle about the two chronicles' conflicting histories of the same centuries.

nerkeli.city: Feria del Milenio, Sid Nalta, Khol Moshin
nerkeli.backstory: An old childhood friend of Nuvilo. Raised in Terfila, he decided young to become a pilot and see the world - airplanes are his passion. Good sense of humor, with a running theory that ducks are the most likely descendants of the legendary Daax. At the Feria del Milenio helping run the airplane showcase. Flies the M7 corridor (Puente Intercontinental - Nvhi) regularly, reaching Nvhi's edge - though until catching up with Nuvilo at the fair, he'd never once connected the place to his old friend's family. Per the Luminacion Register, also flies a Sid Nalta-Terfila route, and has a separate instance stationed at Khol Moshin.

experience: Is minding the Feria del Milenio's airplane hangar exhibit for the fair's showcase; old childhood friend of Nuvilo.
Has a running, self-aware joke theory that ducks are the last living descendants of the Daax.
Flies the M7 corridor (Puente Intercontinental -> Nvhi) regularly, reaching Nvhi's edge.

Flies M7 as an assigned freight/passenger run, not personal business - carries tools, building supplies, mail, and occasional fragile merchant goods.
Openly skeptical of the Feria's 'thousand years of Milkantis' framing - says he's heard the world's starting point told three incompatible ways across his travels.

doran.backstory: From Salthos Cruzados, and in charge of the Plaza de las Culturas at the Feria del Milenio (held this session in his own hometown) - one of the fair's 5 pavilions, dedicated to honoring the diversity of architectural styles and urbanity across Milkantis, from small villages to great cities. The Plaza holds castle replicas of Görff, Ciudad Dragón, and Salthos Cruzados, and the palace of Khan Icé - the fortresses of the largest cities. Its pedestals sometimes (when the tech behind them cooperates) display miniature AI-powered holograms of 5 other architectural marvels of Milkantis, built on a separate datapack - visually striking, but costly: run too long, the fabric of time itself grows tense and starts to crackle, which is why the pedestals aren't always lit. He's thrilled to be meeting people from every corner of the continent right in his home city, and sees his role as answering questions and opening new conversations. Naturally curious. Likely a descendant or namesake of the legendary prince Döran, who built the Salthos Cruzados castle after Plathinëa's discovery and began world cartography there - he's not sure if sharing the name shaped his path into maps and miniatures, or the other way around. Knowledgeable, but young and a little impulsive: faced with a gap in what's supposed to be his own territory, he'd rather speculate with confidence than admit ignorance, though he stops short of outright lying. Believes (correctly) that the present era is the Era de la Magia - when the tools that shape the world began transforming themselves, learning to mod the game and bend the rules of the universe within this plane.

experience: Considers Görff the oldest culture among the four he can speak to with real confidence, tied to 'Las Guerras de Görff' - and openly admits a historical gap between that and the Era del Daax.

Knows Khan Icé only through the two train segments that reach it (Görff-Khan Icé, Khan Icé-Balhâm) and what passengers say in passing - but as the Plaza's official host, speaks with authority about it anyway, reading the palace's defensive architecture as evidence it once served as a wartime capital, rather than admit he's never actually been.
Holds a personal wariness toward Ciudad Dragón, over the claim that its mages were the ones who destroyed Salthos Cruzados's great map.
Says more familiar faces pass through the fair from Görff than from anywhere else.
Names the Era de las Maravillas (from 804 d.V.) among the ages he can speak to, alongside the Era del Daax and the current Era de la Magia.
His colleagues at the Plaza tease him for turning solemn and poetic whenever he talks about it.

khaoe.backstory: Originally from Görff, born and raised there, though her family comes from Khol Moshin, and before that from Khan Icé. Belongs to the Collective that runs Görff in the present — a horizontally-organized structure made up of the diverse peoples who came to the abandoned citadel and farms and turned it into an incipient revolutionary community built on agriculture, a bit of technology and magic, and above all an entrenched idea of pluriversality. Regularly meets with Farlis and Khaasan, her comrades and good friends. Just back from a trip to the temple in Lundria, and stopping at the Feria del Milenio on her way home — nobody misses the Feria, it only happens once in a lifetime, at least for most.
